For any r use the dipole with zero r and pole q to get F_r; the quotient (F-F(r))/F_r is holomorphic and bounded outside the pole discs, hence globally bounded and therefore constant on a nonGreen surface. It is nonzero by evaluating at p or q, so F takes the value F(r) only at r. Thus F is injective.
